content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-2. - State law applicable.

faqs.a:
C.R.S. title 44, arts. 3, 4 and 5, as amended, and the rules and regulations of the
               executive director of the department of revenue of the state, or the deputy director
               thereof if the executive director so designates, as the state licensing authority,
               shall apply to the licensing of fermented malt beverages and malt, vinous and spirituous
               liquors within the city, where applicable.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
